summary: All round-1 critical/major findings successfully addressed across the 14 re-validated tasks. Tasks now conform to task.md.template structure, frontmatter is type-safe, sections are in the correct order, no template placeholders remain, all skill paths resolve to `../../../.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, Decision 10 sole-writer routing is consistent (T3 owns recordCustomFieldsSet/addTag/removeTag, T5 calls them, T8 routes through T3), download endpoint ordering (T9) is token-first per spec, AppException.gone factory is added with unit test, GridFS metadata.rowCount back-fill is documented, canonical slug regex `^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$` is enforced byte-for-byte across T8/T10/T11, ClockConfig at `backend/src/main/java/com/botfunnel/common/ClockConfig.java` is pinned, Vitest spec ownership is cleanly split between T10 (SendPersonalMessageDialog + SubscribersFilterBar) and T11 (AddTagDialog + AddCustomFieldDialog), and QA report paths are aligned at `work/09-subscribers/logs/qa/pre-deploy-qa-report.md` everywhere. Zero critical findings remain. Only minor cosmetic/consistency observations are noted below — none block approval.
